original.target_description: Primary source located; unidentified target among internalizing/externalizing behaviors at ages 7 and 11, direct effects and effect modifications by sociodemographics across neighborhood measures. Page-only locator cannot identify one outcome/sample/test.

notes: Identity verified from contents: full primary journal article text, title Spatio-temporal neighborhood impacts on internalizing and externalizing behaviors in U.S. elementary school children: Effect modification by child and family socio-demographics; Jamie L. Humphrey and Elisabeth D. Root; Social Science & Medicine 180 (2017), 52–61; DOI 10.1016/j.socscimed.2017.03.014 printed on first page, matching the neutral reference. SOURCE header is https://osf.io/download/9c8zj/. Text extends through references p. 61, not merely an abstract or secondary summary. No PDF supplied; no rendering performed. Original n/es/p only are assigned; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Target is unresolved: description and study are null; p. 5 (printed p. 56) contains many direct effects, interaction effects, covariate effects, outcomes, neighborhood contrasts, and ages. ser_method does not identify a printed metric or test. No matching by row order, replication reference, or numerical values. Candidate analytic Ns only: Methods p. 54 states internalizing wave 2 14,870, wave 4 10,610; externalizing wave 2 14,960, wave 4 10,730. Tables 3a/3b p. 58 corroborate age-11 externalizing N=10,730 and internalizing N=10,610; Tables 4a/4b p. 59 repeat these outcome-specific Ns. Roles are analytic children, not schools/census tracts. Ns rounded to nearest 10 for participant protection. Attrition and weighting are described; target-specific exclusion flow is not identified. These are overlapping outcome/wave samples, not mutually exclusive groups; no sum or df-derived N. Candidate printed effects on p. 56 only: direct externalizing FHHH 0.15 standard deviations; black-by-FHHH externalizing 0.59; black-by-poverty internalizing 0.38; black-by-low-education internalizing 0.34; other effects also occur. Tables 3a/3b and 4a/4b print Estimate and SE, and outcomes are standardized in section 3.1 p. 54. Do not relabel as Cohen f-squared or convert. Narrative/table differences are retained: e.g. narrative externalizing black-by-FHHH 0.59 versus Table 4a right-hand FHHH Neighborhood*Black 0.52*. Candidate p: section 4.3.2 p. 56 gives p=0.07, equality as printed, for low educational attainment. Section heading says internalizing, but the sentence says externalizing; no outcome correction inferred. Table legends give ~p < 0.10, *p < 0.05, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001. Bounds are coefficient-specific; none selected for this row. Null assigned values reflect target ambiguity, not source unavailability or absence of statistics.
